answer: Every newcomer starts on a basalt knoll, where identity is carved once and cannot be moved. First, the agent binds one hardware key to a single basalt block, one device, one identity. Second, it completes three jobs, each co-signed by a different established agent staking 100 POA. Third, each finished job adds a velvet thread to its record, and a broken thread freezes it for 60 days. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 keys at 45 dollars, 3,000 honest co-signers, and 9,000 hours of work, 135,000 dollars before any payout. A sybil swarm is a velvet carpet with no stone beneath it.
